---
title: "CDAT 4001 — Data Science"
---

Welcome to CDAT 4001. These course materials develop an applied data-science
workflow from data acquisition and exploratory analysis through modeling,
recommendation, networks, and responsible data practice.

Use the sidebar to move through the concept lessons, worked examples, hands-on
labs, and unit mini-projects.

## Course coverage

| Unit | Lessons | Status |
|------|---------|--------|
| I — Introduction | L01–L02 | Complete |
| II — Big Data | L03–L06 | Complete |
| III — Exploratory Data Analysis | L07–L10 | Complete |
| IV — Data Mining | L11–L15 | Complete |
| V — Visualization and Linear-Algebra Foundations | L16–L21 | Complete |
| VI — Recommender Systems | L22–L24 | Complete |
| VII — Social Networks | L25–L26 | Complete |
| VIII — Governance | L27–L28 | Complete |
